skill_name: Write a narrative paragraph about a time you made a mistake.
workflow: I was embarrassed when I realized I had made a mistake. It was a lesson learned I won't forget. I went out to meet my friends and had to check a couple of items off of my to-do list before meeting them. I had always been careful not to forget anything, double- and triple-checking everything had become a routine. This time, however, I had made a miscalculation and skipped an important step. I was so ashamed that all I wanted to do was to go home and hide in my bed, never to be seen again. Fortuna
